## A self-contained lesson

[Reading a confidence interval](demos/front-matter.qmd) is a complete lesson
whose five entries sit in its own front matter. It renders to HTML and PDF from
one `.qmd` file.

## Research article

Use symbols and rich definitions without interrupting the prose:

```yaml
- id: sample-size
  term: sample size
  plural: sample sizes
  symbol: $n$
  definition: The number of units included in an analysis, represented by $n$.
```

```markdown
The [[sample-size]] was fixed before analysis. Sensitivity checks used larger
[[sample-size|plural]]. In the equations, [[sample-size|symbol]] denotes the
number of observations.
```

## Software documentation

An acronym can expand once and then remain concise:

```markdown
The client calls the [[api]]. The [[api]] returns [[metadata]] as JSON.
```

Rendered here: The client calls the [[api]]. The [[api]] returns [[metadata]].

## A definition in a table caption

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `identifier` | A [[doi]] or another stable key |
| `format` | [[html]] or [[pdf]] |
: Publication fields used by a [[reproducible-research]] workflow. {#tbl-publication-fields}

The balloon remains visible outside the responsive table container.

## Course or handbook website

Use glossary markup in a heading without changing navigation layout:

```markdown
## [[reproducible-research]] checklist

Body references still receive an interactive definition.
```

The heading is plain text in the rendered page and table of contents. The body
reference remains interactive.

## Multiple lists on one page

The default placeholder creates separate Acronyms and Glossary sections:

```markdown
::: {.glossary}
:::
```

Customize the reader-facing labels without changing the vocabulary:

```markdown
::: {.glossary
      title="Key concepts"
      acronym-title="Abbreviations"
      level="2"}
:::
```

## Literal wording

Semantic form names are reserved in the alias position. Prefix a value with
`=` when the visible text should literally be that word:

```markdown
The interface labels this field [[metadata|=short]].
```

For any other custom wording, write it directly after the pipe. The reference
still links and indexes the configured entry.
